TaskItem.title: TaskItem
TaskItem.description: Represents a user task with priority, reminders, notes, and multimedia attachments.

userId.description: The authenticated user ID who owns this task

description.description: Detailed notes or body text for the task

dueDate.description: Due date timestamp in milliseconds or null if no due date

hasReminder.description: Whether an alarm reminder notification is scheduled

audioPath.description: Local file path or identifier for attached audio voice note

audioDurationSeconds.description: Duration of attached audio note in seconds

imageUris.description: List of local or cloud photo URI paths attached to this task

subtasks.description: Checklist subtasks items with title and completion state

updatedAt.description: Last update timestamp. Submitted as FieldValue.serverTimestamp()

/users/{userId}/tasks/{taskId}.description: User specific tasks collection isolated by user ID
